desc_en: A fluid silhouette defined by an art-inspired print. This mid-length robe features relaxed bell sleeves and an adjustable tie belt. Crafted entirely from polyester, it offers a lightweight and silky feel. A versatile piece designed for refined lounging and effortless home dressing. Made to order. Worldwide shipping.
desc_es: Una silueta fluida definida por un diseño de inspiración artística. Esta bata de largo medio presenta mangas acampanadas y un cinturón ajustable. Confeccionada completamente en poliéster, ofrece un tacto ligero y sedoso. Una pieza versátil diseñada para el descanso refinado y el uso diario en casa. Made to order. Worldwide shipping.
